package.name: interfaces
package.description: Custom message types shared across AffectGuard-HRI packages: EmotionState (FR-1 perception output / fused_emotion_state), AudioChunk (raw PCM input for the audio perception node), CurrentTask (FR-2 policy engine input) and BehaviorCommand (FR-2 policy engine output / core/cmd). Not listed as a top-level folder in the spec's illustrative repo tree (section 6), but required because ROS 2 custom messages can only be generated from an ament_cmake package with rosidl_generate_interfaces, which a pure-Python perception/ package cannot do itself. See docs/decisions/0002-interfaces-package.md.
